name: ALLIANZ
recent: Allianz Malaysia 在 2026 年 11 月 27 日公布第三季业绩，净利同比下滑 16.3% 至 1.959 亿令吉。公司表示高净值客户群具有强劲的双位数增长潜力。此外，EPF 在 9 月底至 11 月底期间多次申报其作为大股东的持股变动。
notable: 2026 年第三季净利同比下滑 16.3% 至 1.959 亿令吉。

risks: EPF 在 9 月底至 11 月底期间多次申报持股变动。

recent_en: Allianz Malaysia reported a 16.3% year-on-year decline in 3Q net profit to RM195.9 million on 27 Nov 2026. The company sees strong double-digit growth potential in the high-net-worth segment. EPF also filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between end-September and end-November.
notable_en: 3Q 2026 net profit fell 16.3% year-on-year to RM195.9 million.
The company sees strong double-digit growth potential in the high-net-worth segment.
EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between end-September and end-November.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between end-September and end-November.
